description: Compare 2–10 existing eSIM plan IDs returned by search_plans or get_plan. Returns each matching plan plus the IDs of the cheapest plan, lowest EUR price per GB where calculable, and longest validity; an unknown plan ID is flagged not_found rather than silently replaced. Use for an explicit shortlist, not as the initial destination search; this makes no reservation or purchase.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).

plan_ids.description: Two to ten exact plan IDs from search_plans; unknown IDs are reported as not_found.

name: compare_plans
title: Compare plans
